rationale: DD has gapped up 6.12% on 5.16x relative volume with no news catalyst identified, making the move difficult to interpret directionally. The current price ($150.88) sits well below VWAP ($152.56) and in the lower third of today's range (33.7%), suggesting selling pressure after the initial spike to $154.67, but the bid-ask spread of 105 bps is extremely wide, creating significant slippage risk that erodes any edge. With no clear structural level to anchor a thesis and the wide spread making precise risk management unreliable, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
